plan_reuse_teaching.note: CPU work, not measured critical-path time

moe_teaching.routing_assumption: independent uniform top-k without replacement per token; not a measured routing distribution
moe_teaching.logical_load_note: whole BF16 expert weights once per batch, before TP sharding, cache effects and re-reads

startup_teaching.note: Teaching inputs; execution step count is not output token count

attention_tile_teaching.scope: paper B200 single-SM throughput inputs and instruction shapes; not observed kernel latency

fleet_goodput_teaching.scope: invented homogeneous GPU pool observations for a fixed training target, not Google production results

chunk_attention_teaching.scope: Logical unmasked QK/PV work only; not executed padding FLOPs, latency or HBM traffic

prefill_queue_teaching.scope: Teaching inputs, Poisson same-length requests, deterministic FCFS, balanced PP, negligible handoff; not tail SLO or measured Qwen time

kv_transfer_teaching.scope: Assumed effective payload bandwidth, full KV per request, no prefix reuse; no measured hardware or exposed latency claim

nano_batch_teaching.scope: Teaching durations, not GPU observations; logical FFN weights with no reuse between microbatches; one N->C chain per microbatch.

multi_nic_teaching.scope: Teaching effective one-way rates; symmetric receiver, idle borrowed NICs, sufficient HBM except explicit fabric variant; excludes control, queueing and remapping.

ollama_slots_teaching.scope: Logical BF16 full-history GQA state budget, no prefix reuse; physical allocation and parsed context semantics require backend evidence.

rl_logprob_teaching.scope: Independent teaching assumptions, not measured model error. correct_ratio and wrong_ratio concern current/behavior only; the recomputed value can be a valid old-training denominator for a separately defined update ratio. clip_upper is the stated diagnostic threshold, not a claimed AReaL loss. Same token, conditional prefix and positive support.

rl_supply_teaching.scope: fixed aggregate capacities; reject proportion and filter location are teaching assumptions, not AReaL measurements

rl_coscheduling_teaching.scope: Teaching steady state, one rollout and one training pool; on-policy dependencies preserved; switch cost attached once per phase. Not measured Qwen times.

rl_recovery_teaching.scope: Previous checkpoint durably committed, complete current rollout external to failed trainer; partial update uncommitted. Detection and restart costs equal to isolate saved replay.

graph_selection_teaching.scope: Fixed illustrative kernel-chain time isolates handoff overhead; not Qwen batch runtime. Extra D2D copy modeled by HBM read+write traffic. All assumed overheads are exposed and serial.

network_phase_teaching.scope: Teaching inputs, fixed offered periodic demand; no GPU/CC simulation or execution-time prediction.

torus_route_teaching.scope: First three reduce-scatter rounds only, 16-node bidirectional physical ring, one message per node per round, unique shortest path, no speedup claim for full collective.

checkpoint_layout_teaching.scope: Unfused logical Qwen3-8B gate_proj, TP along output rows; metadata/byte arithmetic only, not a vLLM file conversion.

checkpoint_pipeline_teaching.scope: Rounded 8B teaching model, BF16 weights plus three FP32 Adam arrays at a step boundary; excludes gradients, CPU/data/RNG/metadata, replication and storage amplification. Aggregate effective storage bandwidth, not per-host rate.

communication_tuning_teaching.scope: Qwen3-8B supplies matrix sizes only. Timing inputs are invented teaching observations for two dependency-independent microbatch fragments released together and joined at completion; not a GPU benchmark or full training-step speedup.

workload_mix_teaching.scope: Declared constant-rate fluid workload calculation, not GPU or framework measurement. First output token is produced by prefill; each positive-output request needs O-1 per-sequence decode token steps. Batch execution counts its participating sequence-token steps, not one kernel call. Initially ignores P-to-D dependency, KV, batch efficiency and service variability; backlog is not request latency.

speculative_budget_teaching.scope: Four steady non-ending requests; declared conditional per-position probabilities, graph tiers and constant plus per-row times. Not a measured model, algorithm guarantee or actual framework configuration. k extra proposals plus one existing target input row per request. EOS, output truncation, scheduling drift and interference excluded.

rollout_tail_teaching.scope: Declared hypothetical trajectories/times, independent sampling slots and ideal DP work scaling; not measured GPU results or a RollPacker quality prediction.

weight_offload_teaching.scope: Hypothetical effective rates, unquantized BF16 matrices, uniform independent top-k routing and declared serial GPU-copy model; no measured runtime or model-quality prediction.

multimodal_stage_teaching.scope: Fixed Qwen3-VL-4B shapes, BF16 without token pruning. Bandwidth, service rates and joint timing are teaching assumptions, not benchmarks.

pool.cache_location: encoder_side; full EC transferred on both hit and miss; cache lookup/read/write excluded

dlo_report_recalculation.scope: B300 Cosmos3-Super 1024x1024 T2I only; historical table values, not equal latency or a new experiment

takehome.scope: Static scalar baseline; conditional lower bounds, not execution or universal optimum

agent_events.scope: Declared constant event arrival and effective departure; payload-only memory, not Collector queue settings or measured deployment guarantee

pcie_staging_teaching.scope: Hypothetical one-buffer host-staged paths; traffic not resident capacity; lower bounds not measured times. No extra CPU copy/cache/protocol/startup/shared-host-bridge modeling.

kernel_orchestration_teaching.scope: TP1, same FP8 group128/FP32-scale variant, no padding/UE8M0, input dies after last use, outputs allocated on demand; logical traffic and active tensor payload, not measured HBM traffic/allocator residency. No GPU run.

paper_candy_figure12.conditions: Paper-reported V100/FP32 historical subgraph, not reproduced locally.

cache_tiers_routing_teaching.note: Teaching queue, service and effective bandwidth assumptions; whole-state serial L3->host->GPU with transfer overlapping queue wait. Different pipeline needs a different dependency graph. No measured latency claim.

structured_generation_teaching.note: Teaching assumptions: full packed masks, materialized FP32 logits and separate mask pass. Logical service bounds are not measured HBM traffic or latency; real padding, constrained row count, threading, fusion and overlap must be checked.

retrieval_generation_teaching.note: Independent teaching conditions, not IKS measured speedups or current engine performance. Main transformer matrices only; effective prefill work estimate excludes nonmatrix/queue/transfer/sampling overhead. Vector workload uses 2-byte storage; plain Faiss Flat uses FP32 and twice the corpus bytes.

expert_dispatch_resizing_teaching.scope: Offline single-layer dispatch and conditional link/timing arithmetic, not an executable Qwen LPLB setup, full deployment feasibility or measured performance.

cache_events_routing_teaching.assumptions: Fixed two-point teaching distribution; hit probability is calibrated input, not router scoring weight. No serving benchmark.

weight_handoff_teaching.scope: Logical BF16 parameters and explicit teaching resource/time assumptions; routed experts only for network lower bounds. No serving/training measurements.

buffer_capacity_teaching.operation: Single BF16 FFN up projection; separate gate branch and down projection excluded
buffer_capacity_teaching.assumptions: Output-stationary m,n,k loop: one A/W block, FP32 accumulator across all K, no retained inputs between output tiles, no double buffering or C read. Ideal two-level traffic, not automatically HBM bytes or an optimal lower bound.

host_transfer_teaching.assumption: Independent microbatch activation reload blocks, one preparation lane, one H2D lane and one compute lane; no contention or per-block allocation. Host preparation includes the required CPU copy. Not whole training activation memory or measured hardware.

bank_layout_teaching.scope: Independent scalar FP32 scratch-tile example within a Qwen3 projection. Unique addresses, one 32-bit request per lane, no broadcast/vector/MMA/TMA mapping, other traffic or overlap. Service rounds are not whole-kernel latency or speedup. Full BF16 output reorder bytes are logical traffic only, not measured HBM bytes.

kv_format_teaching.scope: Independent teaching format/capacity arithmetic; no page slack, other model state, measured HBM bytes or local performance. Oaken ideal density excludes additional metadata. Historical blog fit is rounded, specific H100/FA3/Llama experiment, not a Qwen threshold.

mesh_slicing_teaching.scope: Qwen3 single gate projection, fixed output-stationary layout, two independent unidirectional row/column rings. Teaching resources are hypothetical, not TPU/GPU specifications or measured performance; HBM traffic/contention, slicing overhead, other layers and backward execution excluded from timing. BF16 outputs do not imply BF16 accumulation.

hybrid_state_teaching.basis: Teaching payload budget from fixed K3 config and SGLang deployment path; no performance measurement

memory_concurrency_teaching.scope: Teaching assumptions, not GPU measurements; whole-device independent 128-byte transactions and latency at the operating point. Reuses Qwen3-8B BF16 logical full-history KV baseline; excludes weights/current-token writes, repeated reads and actual cache traffic.
